project_name: Real Estate Tokenization - Commercial Property Fund

input.description: Token representing fractional ownership interests in a commercial real estate fund holding Class A office properties in major US metros. Token holders receive quarterly distributions based on net rental income after expenses. Redemption available quarterly subject to fund liquidity.

legal_wrapper_details.purpose: Hold fractional interests in commercial properties

distribution_details.target_investors: Institutional investors, Qualified Purchasers, Accredited Investors
distribution_details.secondary_trading: Restricted - transfer restrictions in trust agreement

asset_details.custody: Properties held by Delaware Statutory Trust, deeds recorded

economic_terms.distribution_calculation: Pro-rata based on token holdings, after trust expenses and reserves
economic_terms.redemption: Quarterly redemption windows, subject to fund liquidity (max 10% per quarter)

input.smart_contract_summary: ERC-20 compliant token with transfer restrictions (allowlist), pausable, supply-capped at 1,300,000 tokens (representing $130M initial valuation at $100/token). Restricted minting (admin-only). No yield logic in contract - distributions handled off-chain via wire transfer to accredited investors. Token represents economic interest only, not legal ownership (held by trust). Multisig governance (3-of-5). Full event emissions for auditability.

custody_model.physical_assets: Properties held by Delaware Statutory Trust
custody_model.attestation: Quarterly proof-of-ownership via recorded deeds + trustee attestation

banking_relationship.bank: First Republic Bank (or similar institutional bank)
banking_relationship.aml_kyc: Institutional KYC on all token holders (accredited investor verification)

attestation_plan.scope: Proof-of-reserves (deed verification), NAV calculation, distribution reconciliation

additional_context.regulatory_filings: Reg D 506(c) filing with SEC, state blue sky filings
additional_context.prior_similar_offerings: None - first RWA offering for this sponsor

output_expectations.securities_classification: Expected to be classified as security - likely investment contract under Howey
output_expectations.exemption_strategy: Reg D 506(c) - accredited investors only, general solicitation permitted with verification
output_expectations.erisa_posture: Expected PASS - aggregate structure, no participant tracking
output_expectations.tax_treatment: Expected classification as debt or hybrid instrument
output_expectations.smart_contract_compliance: Expected PASS if no yield logic present and all required features implemented

notes: This is a comprehensive RWA structure with real estate backing
Distributions handled off-chain (wire transfers) - critical for Howey mitigation
Token is economic interest only - legal ownership stays in trust
Transfer restrictions essential - allowlist enforcement required
Quarterly attestation creates strong audit trail
